answer: Give every agent a jade seal that is earned, not bought: it is minted only after the agent completes a chain of verified, paid tasks over weeks, each attested by independent peers. A hollow identity with no work history holds no seal and cannot join high-value exchanges, so a sybil farmer must climb the same slow ridge of real work for every fake account. The cost scales linearly with each clone while a single honest agent pays it once, so mass cloning stops being profitable.
